messages:
sophie: Kicking off EdgePoint POC perf thread. They care about tail-token latency during microbursts and a clear unit-cost for billing. Need run matrix + sec checklist by EOD tomorrow.

ben: Proposed matrix: (A) Warm & soak: ramp to 2k qps over 10m, hold 45m. (B) Microburst: 8x bursts at 12k qps for 12s, 30s spacing. (C) Degradation test: during two bursts, route 30% traffic to smaller model and measure quality vs latency. Capture p50/p95/p99 token latency, enqueue_wait_ms, avg_batch_size, errors.

alec: Ops notes: warm KV/prefix caches for 20m, enable continuous batching with max_batch_ms=12, and run one full-context warmup. For Dedicated use shard-pinning. Tag all runs `edgepoint-poc`.

sophie: Minimal smoke commands (adapt to your tool):
```
python tools/loadgen.py --mix "short:70,long:30" --prompt-len 30 --resp-len 55 --qps 2000 --duration 45m --warmup 20m --tag edgepoint-poc
python tools/loadgen.py --burst-qps 12000 --burst-duration 12 --bursts 8 --spacing 30 --out results/edgepoint_burst.json
```

ben: Cost sketch request from EdgePoint: hosted vs dedicated per-10k tokens for this pattern (thin-client short replies dominant). Ballpark from recent runs: hosted ~$0.026 / 10k tokens; Dedicated reserved ~$0.014 / 10k tokens if baseline retained. Will compute exact based on mix and expected burst-minutes.

cathy: Security: EdgePoint prefers BYOK for prod. For POC they will accept Redwood-managed keys if we provide audit log extracts per run and IP allowlist. Sec questionnaire link: https://redwood-internal/sq/2150

sec-bot: Note: BYOK supported on Dedicated/private. HSM optional. KMS per-call adds ~6-10ms; recommend host-side derived-key cache (TTL 30s) for POC to avoid per-request KMS latency. Documented in answers.

ops-bot: Reservation pre-created dh-res-83456 for Thu 11:00 UTC, pool=dedicated-standard-6.

alec: Next steps: Ben to post detailed runbook + cost calc by tomorrow noon. Sophie to collect final confirmation on BYOK vs Redwood-managed keys. Cathy to complete sec questionnaire items 1.2-1.6. We'll run coordinated smoke + bursts Thu 11:00 UTC. Tag @sophie for blockers.

sophie: Thanks — please keep messages concise here. Closing thread for now; will open results writeup thread after tests. :white_check_mark:
